name: Listonic
summary: Remove the ads, sale campaigns, rating prompts and trackers from the grocery shopping list, and sign in with Google through MicroG-RE.

android.note: Listonic 9.25.1 needs Android 12L or newer (minSdk 32): every version from there, and the next one, whose image is only in the SDK's canary channel so far. Except Android 13: its x86_64 image has no ARM translation, so neither the original nor the patched app installs there (INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS); on a phone it's fine. The release tries the oldest supported version, the newest stable one and the next one; a pull request the oldest and the newest stable.
